international.summary: Figure up from 4.3% annual rate in September and nearly double Reserve Bank’s official target of 2.5% Follow our Australia politics live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Surging fuel costs and the end of electricity rebates have helped drive inflation to 4.9% in the year to October, from 4.3%, as cost-of-living pressures peak in the lead-up to Christmas. Alongside a 6.3% increase in fuel costs last month, the latest figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics showed electricity prices were 25% higher than a year earlier. Continue reading...
